Back to School DJ

Homecoming 
Our Bay area School DJs are seasonal professionals we comply with all the guidelines of your school, administration and dance committe. As well as Homecomings a lot of schools book us for all the years dances and we have been DJing for 18 years, we are professional very experienced and play all the clean new music that the kids like these days.Back to School Middle School Disc Jockey 2026 Special.

Its time for the school dance! So who are you getting as the dj?
California Disc Jockey of course ! We can turn your school gym into dance Night Club!

Dance to the sounds of Rap/Hip Hop, Oldies, Club songs, Disco, Alternative with games mixed in with your usual favourites.You name it we always have request book notepads and paper ready Plus, California Disc Jockey can supply lighting, Photo Booth, Dry Ice Low laying fog, Led Uplighting, Karaoke. extra speakers, giveaway’s and much more. Also we accept song requests in advance, so gather your friends and Contact us with a list at Submit Your List.

We do have two SPECIALS currently:
Book your ENTIRE School year’s dances and receive a discount on each!
Special Intelligent  Lighting OR Get 5 Led Uplights rental free at your Dance.
” See the New Songs We Have – Latest Hits.”

Sound System
We are ‘In-Touch’ with all the current music preferences of teens. However, we always respect and comply with the school administrations guidelines and security. Most disc-jockeys utilize a sound system designed to be used at small to medium sized events. These sound systems usually include two medium sized speakers and a mid-sized amplifier.While this type of sound system is suitable for weddings and other private parties, they are not suitable when used in gymnasium or other large rooms with 100 – 3000 students.

There are two factors that make a larger sound system necessary at most school dances:
The size of a room used for a school dance is three or four times larger than the average banquet hall. In addition, the height of the ceiling absorbs sound quickly.The average number of students attending a school dance is 250 people. The sheer quantity of people absorb sound. This is the most important factor!!Gym or Cafeteria ?.
 
When a regular DJ sound system is used at a school dance inside a gymnasium or other large room or multi purpose room,  the disc-jockey quickly realises that he or she cannot get enough sound out of the system to fill the room. This usually results in the DJ pushing the small sound system to its maximum limits. When this happens, you usually get an “ear-piercing” amount of treble coming out of the speakers in an effort to play “louder”.

” The Big Sound System “
When a large state-of-the-art sound system is used for a school dance, you get a totally different sound.Instead of an ear-piercing loud noise, you get a deep, rich, crystal-clear sound that is pleasing to the ear. It is hard to believe but we actually get fewer loud volume complaints with our large sound system than the smaller one. The reason is because we let the bass fill the gym, not the ear-piercing treble. In contrast to a regular DJ sound system, our large deluxe sound system utilizes four large speakers, and an amplifier that has four times the power of our regular one.The end result difference between our regular sound system and our deluxe is comparable to a boom box and a full sized stereo system. The choice is yours. Choose the sound system and service that you feel will best serve your needs. Please call us if you have any questions.

Bay Area Music
Note: (We only play All Clean Music radio edit) We have the music you want all clean versions. We keep up with all the latest music, including Rap, Dance, Alternative rock Michael Jackson, and Top 40.In an effort to ensure that we have what you want, we encourage you to submit a list of requests prior to the event. No other DJ company can match our level of service to provide the students with the music they want to dance to!

Disc-Jockey interaction 
The amount of interaction we provide depends greatly on the school. Typically, for elementary and middle schools, we are very outgoing and interactive by providing games and contests for the students. We highly recommend that the school provide ten to fifteen door prizes for this approach, as it is the students incentive to participate in the games and contests we can supply some of the prizes.In contrast, at most high school events, we are there to provide our awesome sound and lighting system, and play the music the students want to dance to! In most cases, high school students are not interested in games and contests, but we are happy to provide this approach upon request. Some popular group dances include Cupid Shuffle, Cha Cha Slide, The Mannequin Challenge Song.

Back to School & Homecoming DJ – Questions & Answers
Why choose California Disc Jockey for school events?
Our Bay Area School DJs are experienced professionals who have been performing for 18+ years. We comply with school administration and dance committee guidelines, play clean, current music that students love, and bring the energy to make your homecoming or back-to-school event unforgettable.

Call ☎ 1-415-350-5474 to book your school dance today.
What services do you provide for school dances?
We can transform your school gym into a dance nightclub experience! Our services include:
  • Professional Sound Systems (Standard & Deluxe)
  • Photo Booth & Karaoke
  • Dry Ice Low-Lying Fog & LED Uplighting
  • Intelligent Dance Lighting
  • Song Request Submission in Advance
Special Offers: • Book the entire school year’s dances for discounts. • Free LED uplights with select packages!
Do you provide different sound systems?
Yes! Most DJs bring small systems meant for weddings, which fail in gyms with 250+ students.

Our Deluxe System:
  • 4 Large Speakers + High-Power Amplifier
  • Deep bass for a rich, clear sound without ear-piercing treble
  • Perfect for gymnasiums and large cafeterias
The result is a professional, club-like experience that students love.
What music do you play for schools?
We only play radio-edit, clean versions of popular music, including: Hip Hop, Rap, Top 40, Club Hits, Michael Jackson, Alternative, and Classic Party Songs.

We also encourage schools to submit song requests in advance to guarantee a playlist tailored to your students.
Do you interact with students during the event?
Interaction depends on the school level:
  • Elementary & Middle School: Highly interactive with games & contests
  • High School: Focus on music, lighting, and a nightclub feel (games optional)
Popular group dances include Cupid Shuffle, Cha Cha Slide, and The Mannequin Challenge Song.
Which schools do you serve?
We serve hundreds of Bay Area schools, including: Abraham Lincoln High (SF), Alameda High, Albany High, Amador High, Antioch High, Balboa High (SF), Cupertino High, Del Mar High, Lowell High (SF), Lynbrook High, Milpitas High, Mission High, San Jose High, Saratoga High, and more across Northern California.

We also perform at universities like Stanford, UC Berkeley, UC Davis, SJSU, and CSU campuses for college events, grad nights, and faculty parties.
How to book your school DJ?
Contact us for Back-to-School, Homecoming, Prom, or Graduation DJ services. We offer free event planning assistance and emergency party planning.

☎ (800) 568-0443 – Reserve your school event DJ today!
